question: Who composed the music of the patriotic song ‘Maa Tujhe Salaam’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AR Rahman**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **AR Rahman** is the composer of the iconic patriotic song 'Maa Tujhe Salaam'.
 
• The song is part of the album **Vande Mataram**, which was released in 1997.
 
• AR Rahman is a renowned Indian music composer, singer, and music producer, known for his contributions to Indian cine
